identification: Upright mahogany cabinet gramophone, red-backed fretwork grille, double doors below, lift lid, nickel soundbox arm. Style is Victor Victrola VV-X / XI class or HMV/Columbia equivalent, 1910s to 1920s. No maker plate legible in the photo; the title spelling 'Vitrola' is unconfirmed. Mass-produced, common type.

viewing_check: Look for maker plate or transfer inside the lid (Victor, HMV, Columbia, Pathe, Australian made), model number, original crank and soundbox, whether the turntable turns and motor runs, veneer lifting or cracks, and any rare or jazz records (red label) in the lot.
